svg.text: Delay doing something until a later time.
I kept putting off the appointment until I finally
Separable: put off the meeting / put the
meeting off / put it off. Before another action,
use -ing: put off making a decision, not put off
A: Have you booked the checkup?
B: Not yet. I have been putting it off.
A: Could you stop putting it off and book it this
B: Yes. I will call after lunch instead of delaying
Write a sentence about something you have
been putting off, followed by a concrete next
